title: Tests, issues and assumptions
intro: Every O2S test file with what it proves and its last result, then the open issues, older registers, assumptions nobody has confirmed, known limits, review reports and the security register. Read the totals first; each item names its source.

rows: Print-on-pack is open to whoever may create a PO (asked of the access matrix, not role names); a job may say it is blocking now (due), not only how long it waited.

15e rulings: the date box keeps the picked date and opens the late-reason box; shift starts empty and records the person; Run-sheet Pack opens the pressed batch; by-product cannot be the same product; QA Pass at or over the reject number needs a reason.

15f rulings: one stuck rule per order line (7 days); 1 vehicle and driver rule; Start loading sheet with a safe batch change; sent-back fix sheet; Truck released and Handed to driver; truck job clocks; shared jobs; QA by pack type; look-alike batch refused once; new trucks reserve their exact packing runs.

15g rulings: a line is moving when the same client and product was packed in 7 days; Waiting for production, X of Y ready; both cards; bulk-base run stalled after 4 days with no output; day 7 Stuck at packing job for Supply Chain: Close short or Waiting for client (1 to 30 days).
Build 16a: read and sign once; the System documentation fails the build when a Guide rule, a build, a role or a data list has no entry, or an item lacks an id, owner, status or its question.

The month on the bag (month of packing, expiry 24 to 36, the printed month and its flag, the 3 correction sheets), Night shift dated tomorrow, Packed in 2 months across POs with the note, the inspector from the login and refused on own run, the remark on a flagged Dates match, the 3 old rules, Correct a record, Guide R-038 and the changelog. Review fixes: Correct the month from Batch trace (month fields only, register lines), the pre-shipment report line per bag month, the inspection paper, made-on for pools, and + Log a shift always showing the list.

The inspection record prints the runs each inspection checked (packed lot, truck, old per-lot QA, 2 runs once each, mixed 16b and older runs, withdrawn), says when its runs are no longer on record, never borrows another PO's id-less row, falls back to the first run only when no run ids were ever carried; a mutation of the old line is caught.
Departments, roles and rights: every converted gate answers exactly as before, per role and per right, live and not live; a lead cannot widen himself.
The print-decision backlog screen: one definition of the backlog, honest evidence, and the same gate for opening and saving.
Closing a batch lists every batch with quantities to untick; the Plant Manager can reopen with a reason.
A batch number correction is asked, then approved by the COO; the DC and inspection lines of that run follow.
A batch may run up to 115% of plan; Log more output comes back; closing short is unchanged.
HG26025: correcting a batch's produced quantity is a proper correction (reason, register, Plant Manager or COO); a certified lot's entry cannot be voided.
Batch trace: which brands, brand batches, POs and trucks a batch went into, and whether the figures agree.
Money: only COO, CFO, Plant Manager and KAM see money figures; budget by channel and client, FY July to June.
BUILD_ID and the changelog move together, so the newer-version banner and the What's changed notice fire.
AP26012: a certified duplicate lot can be put right only by superseding its certificate, and the way to do it is reachable.
Closed short is its own eighth stage, neither open nor delivered, and leaves fulfilment % on both sides.
A close-short reason must fit the stock: a line packed in full cannot be closed as 'We could not supply'.

Complaints: working days and holidays, raise and route, job keys end with the complaint (B1), the hold in every free-stock count and at the truck (B2), role checks (B3), 2 saves at once keep both steps (B4), a person who left or moved (B5), investigate, accept with tests, replies, resolve, actions checked and tested, close needs every step, cancel releases holds, reopen, the outcome report without responsibility or cost, away, numbers, repeats, batch correction, alert routes and text, the brief to read and sign.
A customer added by anyone but the CFO or COO waits for CFO approval before its first order.
Customer and dealer rows carry stable ids so 2 people saving at once do not wipe each other; dealer codes use the region and city picked.
The dashboard renders for every role, tab and period with no error.
Add missing packing needs a QC-approved batch and sets its numbers and dates like a normal pack; a packing entry can be voided with a reason.
Correct a record writers have a permission check; the bulk print-on-pack screen cannot set every PO to no price unasked.
Who signs a truck out: the warehouse loads and issues the gate pass, Saad reviews, the Plant Manager approves the DC and releases; 2 hour rule; delivery confirm order.
Dispatch rights (plan, load, gate pass, confirm delivery) and procurement rights (RM check, receive, close PR, acknowledge PO) are decided by the grant, not by the screen a person stands on.
Every printable opens with a Back to O2S and Print bar that never prints and never changes the paper.
New order redesign keeps every field and check: 4 sections, one card per product.
Every paper is easy to find: the order's Papers list, each paper under the rule it already has.
The Plant (Firefighter) view: delayed orders, material bottlenecks and shipping holds with counts; it writes nothing.
Save path: the merge baseline is set on opening, and a failed save does not stop the tab pulling changes.

26a floor list: Close batch is offered when no more is needed; the Production Manager closes per line; 'Supplied from stock outside O2S' reason; the Plant Manager sees the DC and gate pass before he approves.
After a 409 or an auto-refresh the merge baseline is the server copy, so a closed batch does not come back open.
List A (07e): fixes that could make stock or numbers wrong, including DC and gate pass number clashes after a merge.
List B (07f): approvals that could be slipped past.
List C (07g): jobs that stalled or misled, including the Pack job for a lab-cleared batch.
List D (07h): screens, wording, design and consistency, including the Reference built from the live app.
07i: the 4 reviewers' findings on 07h, fixed, on the stock move fixture.
An FOC sample never carries a printed price, and the price-on-pack question is not shown as required on an FOC order.
The fresh-eyes audit of 24q: every screen for every role renders with no undefined, NaN or overflow; its fixes.
A Gate Pass cannot be issued for a truck whose inspection has not passed (Fault 8, one step further).
The Guide says what each change made it say (pinned lines for every build since 24z).

Held stock: part and full complaint hold, the stage kept, owner and next step from the complaint, not stalled, QA hold with its reason and button, held Kg less trucks, the QA, Shipments, report, dashboard, order sheet and stock move readers. After review: part-packed held line shows the work owed, part shipped with the rest held, the run’s own PO, 2 complaints, mixed holds, 0 Kg runs, closed lines, speed guard, escaping, Production Manager button.
How are we doing: the dashboard figures (on time, sold, late) worked out the way the rules say.
The in-app manual keeps its refreshed content (roles, Reconciliation, the shipment pipeline).
The lab works by parameter: each test assigned to an analyst, with its own time allowance.
Leave cover for the lab: a cover signs 1 line only, the certificate prints for whom, the Plant Manager names the cover.
One delay reason per late order, with a per-line override.
Fix it where it happened: packed, dispatched and delivered cannot be typed; packing cannot pass ordered; a reversed lot does not count.
AP26012: a certified lot can be packed; a duplicate lot can be removed; checked against older baseline files.
The planner sees the batches for a truck, oldest first, and may choose; untouched, nothing changes.
The Back Office manual card covers products, customers, budget and access.
New order: last price, 5% band with a reason, payment terms, ERP SO number.

Alerts on the server against a throwaway MySQL or MariaDB database: switch on, own device only, the first list sends nothing, 1 alert per job and person, never to the person who saved, named person only, escalations only to their role, night hold and the 7 am summary, gone devices removed, Who has alerts on. Skipped unless O2S_ALERTS_TEST_DB is set.

Alerts on the screen: the card states, the job list and its keys, Way 1 sends only new jobs, the 15-minute check only from an up-to-date screen, the job names and escalation targets match the server, the alert text, the night hours, the Guide and the changelog.
A refused pack adds nothing to the PO line or the batch.

Packs shown and confirmed with a tick; a cut over the batch or PO limit is shown; an entry over 10,000 Kg/L (or a shift and in-charge total over it) is flagged to the Production Manager, never stopped.
The 3 live packing entries refuse without a shift and an in-charge, store both, and move nothing when they refuse.
The batch on the bags is checked against each DC line at the truck inspection.
New PO entry redesign: the optional capture fields, the step strip and the order summary.
The 44 old orders with no print-on-pack answer are answered 'no' once, and a later 'yes' is never overwritten.
Production in the new shell: one card per product; every button the same action under the same right.
The Production screen renders on every tab with data in it, with no error.
Production's stuck list draws a live button only for Production's own items, for every role.
The Production Manager and Production split: manager-only rights, floor rights, Data Fix off the floor.
One product master, migrated once from the file; editing it is Back Office (COO, CFO, Plant Manager).
The pre-shipment inspection report names only material on that truck, and only what may go on a customer's copy (real snapshot).
The pre-shipment report printed with the DC for customers ticked for it; the inspection register.
An old truck is judged by what was known when it left.
A price is asked for every list-price product on the truck, once each.
The public lab report check for van.com.pk: the printed number only, every lot approved, newest financial year, only the allowed fields on the report (made-up records).
The pre-shipment inspection is live: no stub pass at dispatch; release needs a real passed inspection.
N/A on an inspection item needs a reason of 5 characters; N/A is refused on items that must be answered.
Reconcile packing agrees with the packing records and flags only real gaps.
A refusal leaves nothing behind (lab bench and 2 other cases).
The old 'one lot tested for the batch' code still works if switched back on (it is off since 13e).
Reports open on All dates (Invoicing, Closed short, Stock moved keep theirs); tables cap at 500 rows with a note.
A department lead opens every report his department may open; the Your reports card.
Fixes from the 25m independent review: Pakistan-time dates, periods and others.
Kind A jobs follow the matrix; Kind B sign-offs stay on hardRole and never follow it (the 30 July incident reproduced).
Raw-material quantity entry takes large numbers and the right unit.
The role name is the join key; built-in roles are locked so they stay stable.
Titles are for display and signatures only and never decide access.
Every money figure is net of FED; a sale counts when the truck leaves.
FOC samples: ask, COO approves, warehouse issues, QA checks (not the issuer), Saad reviews (not the gate pass issuer), Plant Manager releases.
FOC sample DCs and gate passes are listed in Reports, Documents for the roles that may open FOC samples.
The 3-place shell (Today, Plant, Back Office, Guide): navigation, People, jobs and lists render for every role.
Shipments in the new shell; cards, buttons and rights unchanged.
A short close stops new work on a line but never touches what is packed or rewrites ordered (one guard, every writer).
Request, approve, reject and reopen a short close; the requester cannot approve; reopen is COO only.
The short-close report: shortfall by reason and month from the figures frozen at close.
A look-alike brand batch number at packing is caught.
SPEC-06: which price goes on the pack (list, PO price or none) and its windows.
Move packed stock to another PO: same customer, product, price and bag price; Supply Chain asks, Plant Manager approves, the asker cannot.
Stuck batches: stuck per order line after 7 days, queued behind the oldest, held for orders; every row says what, why, when, who.
The 23 Sep rulings: the seeded access cells, customer rights to Finance and CFO, the Warehouse role, Ismaeel's role move, nothing deleted by the build.
Today: the jobs waiting on the signed-in person, grouped, one button each, the app's own action.
Review truck shows for Supply Chain and Warehouse on every list, and never for the one who made the truck.
Saad or Shoaib review a truck; Zain never; not whoever loaded it or issued its gate pass.
Waiting QC shows the whole batch (lots and Kg).
Supply Chain splits into Lead Supply Chain, Warehouse and the assistant; what step 2 removes.
The What's changed notice shows once per version per person.

items.title: Known limits
src: o2s.html saveNow, mergeDupNumbers, startSync, checkForNewBuild, decodeToken
OP-HANDOFF-O2S.md 13 Oct (3), (4), (7); 15 Oct (2), RESUME HERE 15 Oct

list: All O2S data is 1 JSON document, read and written whole; a save over 25 MB is refused.
2 saves at the same moment are merged; audit rows without an id can be lost in the merge (S-09).
DC and gate pass numbers are taken as highest + 1 in each copy; a clash is possible and is said after the merge. A server-side counter is the full answer (25o note).
A role change reaches a person at the next sign in; the token carries the role for 30 days.
The page checks for changes every 7 seconds and for a newer build at most every 10 minutes.
Sign-in failures and public lookups are counted in the server's memory; a restart clears them.
A wrong shift or in-charge cannot be edited after saving: the COO reverses the record and it is entered again.
A PO line with no pack size saves packing without packs and without the tick.
Reports show the first 500 rows; older rows need the period buttons or export.
If Saad loads and Shoaib issues the gate pass (or the reverse), only the COO can review, or the 2 hour lapse lets the Plant Manager release.
A fresh install needs the Setup steps for the Production Manager as Production lead (13 Oct (7)).
